title: Shell command executed through Open3 from a string in ruby — review required
description: Open3.capture3 with a single string runs the command through the shell. A value interpolated into that string is parsed as shell syntax, so a semicolon or backtick appends commands. The rule flags the string form; the argument-array form is the safe counterpart.
remediation: Call capture3 with separate arguments, or capture2e with an explicit array, and validate dynamic values.
limitation: Lexical: matches capture3 calls whose first argument is a variable or interpolated string.

tests.line: # audit: stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3("convert #{user_file} out.png") present
# verified: stdout, stderr, status = Open3.capture3("convert", user_file, "out.png")
